title: References
breadcrumb: Federation Hub: connecting multiple TAK Servers

headings.text: Key facts used in this guide

blocks.html:
Primary sources

  • Federation Hub Configuration Guide (official; Distribution Statement A — approved for public release, v5.7). The authoritative reference for the FedHub: hub-and-spoke architecture, install (RPM/DEB/Docker), ports (9100 UI / 9101 v1 / 9102 v2 / 9103 token), certificates & authorized users, Keycloak admin auth, and the Policy Manager / Policy Editor (CA Group, Outgoing, Token Group nodes; edges; group filtering). Distributed with the TAK Server download (takserver-fed-hub-*).
  • TAK Server Configuration Guide — §12 Federation: direct (point-to-point) federation, sharing CAs, federated group mapping, Mission Federation Disruption Tolerance, and the Data Package and Mission File Blocker. Also the source for TAK Server's own federation ports (9000/9001) and group model.
  • TAK Server source / Federation Hub: https://github.com/TAK-Product-Center/Server.

Companion guides (this site)

  • Integrating to TAK Server — the single-server API, auth (mTLS / Keycloak), groups, and getting/pushing data. The group model there is what the hub's edge filtering acts on.
  • Deploy App docs — Architecture orientation (the per-deployment CA / trust layer: CFSSL on Legacy, opendefence-pki on Kubernetes) and the Keycloak – Group Management / Takserver Groups wiki pages.

Key facts used in this guide

  • Hub ports 9100/9101/9102 (+ optional 9103 token, 9099 OAuth); open 9100 and 9102.
  • TAK Server → hub outgoing connection targets the hub's 9102 (v2).
  • Trust is mutual: server CA (/opt/tak/certs/files/ca.pem) → hub; hub CA (/opt/tak/federation-hub/certs/files/ca.pem) → server federation truststore.
  • Policy must be uploaded/active; the hub denies servers not in the policy; green node = connected.
  • Edge group filtering (Allow All / Allowed / Disallowed / both) decides which Keycloak-named groups cross between deployments; the source must run group mapping for anything beyond Allow All.
